description: This Java source file defines a configuration class for setting up OpenAPI (Swagger) metadata in a Spring Boot application. It primarily customizes the API documentation details such as title, description, version, and external documentation links for the 'Kavia Windows Desktop Emulator API'.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that defines a bean for OpenAPI metadata used by Swagger UI.

methods.name: kaviaOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured OpenAPI object with metadata for the Kavia API.
